title: Bringing the flipped classroom to Marxist-Leninist philosophy: evidence from teaching Indian medical students in Vietnam
reason: Quasi-experiment: all six constructs are self-report Likert scales compared by group; LMS logs (87.3% video completion, 1.8 replays) reported only descriptively and never related per student to any outcome or construct.

extraction.design: quasi-experimental (EG/CG) with mediation analysis, mixed methods
extraction.n_quote: Complete sampling was used, and after five incomplete responses were excluded, the analytic sample was N=420, as described in Table 1.
extraction.population: Indian medical (doctor of medicine) students, 1 university (CTUMP)
extraction.lms_indicators: LMS video completion rate and replay counts (group-level descriptives only)
extraction.outcome_or_construct: self-reported DLA, CLB, SRL, CLA, CTA, TLA scales
extraction.notes: Group differences d=.96-1.74 are EG vs CG on self-report scales, not indicator-outcome relations. Authors note LMS data 'triangulate' only descriptively. Same authors, cohort size (420; 210/210) and six constructs as OUCI2-lmbPyXBP (IJSSHR, April 2026): possible duplicate reporting of one study; E2 not applied because the reported figures differ.
